description: fsGuard.isReadable for paths found by a folder walk: Draggy's own storage and credential names are not readable. Pure path logic, no files. Input: {path, protected}. Expected: a boolean.

cases.name: an ordinary file in the folder is readable
a file under Draggy's storage is not
a folder named like protected storage but not inside it is readable
a credential folder is not readable
a walk that lands in protected storage is not readable
